mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (notification_num, member_num, category, title, message, target_url, is_checked, created_at) VALUES (notifiaction_seq.nextVal, #{member_num}, #{category}, #{title}, #{message}, #{target_url}, 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT notification_num, category, title, message, target_url, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_num = #{member_num}
SELECT notification_num, category, title, message, target_url, created_at FROM notification WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND is_checked = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_checked = 1 WHERE member_num = #{member_num} AND notification_num = #{notification_num}
UPDATE notification SET is_checked = 1 WHERE member_num = #{member_num}
